sql:
SELECT has_promotion, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(order_value) AS average_order_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.orderid,
    (COALESCE(o.comments, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|voucher|special offer|black friday|sale)'
      OR COALESCE(o.internalcomments, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|voucher|special offer|black friday|sale)'
      OR COALESCE(o.deliveryinstructions, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|voucher|special offer|black friday|sale)'
      OR BOOL_OR(COALESCE(ol.description, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|voucher|special offer|black friday|sale)')) AS has_promotion,
    SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
  WHERE o.orderdate >= DATE '2024-11-29'
    AND o.orderdate < DATE '2024-11-30'
  GROUP BY o.orderid, o.comments, o.internalcomments, o.deliveryinstructions
) order_totals
GROUP BY has_promotion
ORDER BY has_promotion DESC
LIMIT 500

      OR COALESCE(o.deliveryinstructions, '') ~* '(promo|discount|coupon|voucher|special offer|black friday|sale)'
